Message.Name: Consolidated Fractional Stock Summary Message
Message.Description: The stock summary message is sent every 1 minute, after a security is Open.

Field.Name: Source Time
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Source Time NS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: Symbol Index
Field.Description: The unique ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: NYSE Group High Price
Field.Description: The High price of the stock for the day. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: NYSE Group Low Price
Field.Description: The Low price of the stock for the day. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Primary Listing Market Official Open Price
Field.Description: The Opening price of the stock for the day received from the listing market.

Field.Name: Fractional NYSE Group Volume
Field.Description: The cumulative volume for the stock during the day, inclusive of any fractional quantity. Implied scale is 6.

Field.Name: NYSE Group Market ID of High Price
Field.Description: The ID of the Originating Market of the High Price.

Field.Name: NYSE Group Market ID of Low Price
Field.Description: The ID of the Originating Market of the Low Price.

Field.Name: Market ID of Open Price
Field.Description: The ID of the Originating Market of the Open Price.

Field.Name: Num Close Prices
Field.Description: The number of Market ID/Official Close Price pairs. Values can be 0 - 1.

Field.Name: NYSE Group Market ID of the Close
Field.Description: The ID of the Originating Market of the Close Price.

Field.Name: Primary Listing Market Official Close Price
Field.Description: The Official Close Price of the stock for the originating market captured in the preceding Market ID field.

Field.Name: Consolidated High Price
Field.Description: The highest price of any high/low eligible transaction on Tapes A, B or C received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Consolidated Low Price
Field.Description: The lowest price of any high/low eligible transaction on Tapes A, B or C received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Consolidated First Price
Field.Description: The price of the first last sale eligible transaction on Tapes A, B, or C received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Consolidated Last Price
Field.Description: The price of the final last sale eligible transaction on Tapes A, B, or C received on the trading day.
